overview.text: The Army plans to detonate the nation's lead azide stockpile in Iowa Wednesday morning, as residents brace for a lead dust cloud.
China is investigating Shanghai party chief Chen Jining, the fourth Politburo member probed since 2025, as Xi's purges expand.
Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO after Trump pushed for it, effectively overriding the company's board.
Intelligence agencies told congressional aides there was no evidence the woman at the center of the Nvidia scandal took direction from Chinese intelligence.
Solomon Islands replaced its security pact with China with a treaty with Australia that precludes foreign military bases.
Six people, including two children, were found dead after a small plane crashed off Mississippi's coast.

stories.headline: Near-freezing mornings expected in San Antonio through Friday
stories.summary: Parts of San Antonio could hit freezing temperatures overnight, with near-freezing mornings forecast through Friday.
stories.why: Matters for Thanksgiving week plans, plants and pets.

stories.headline: San Antonio poverty report: 44% can't afford essentials
stories.summary: The Ready to Work program reports job gains, while a city poverty report finds 44% of residents cannot afford essentials.
stories.why: Shows the city's economic strain and whether job training is helping.

stories.headline: Texas leaders see hope for high-speed rail after midterms
stories.summary: State and local leaders say the Democratic midterm gains have renewed hope for a Texas high-speed rail project.

stories.headline: Army to detonate nation's lead azide stockpile in Iowa Wednesday
stories.summary: The Army plans to detonate nearly five tons of lead azide at the Iowa ammunition plant in Middletown around 9 a.m. CST. Nearby residents are bracing for a toxic lead dust cloud, and the Army says there is no reason to panic.
stories.why: Nearby residents face possible health and environmental effects from lead dust.

stories.headline: Plane crash off Mississippi coast kills six, including two children
stories.summary: The Coast Guard says six people were found dead after a small plane crashed off Mississippi, near Horn Island. Crews had found the cabin, a life raft and life jackets.

stories.headline: Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan to petition to delay execution
stories.summary: Hasan, who killed 13 people at the Texas Army post in 2009, told a federal court he will file a petition to delay his execution by firing squad.

stories.headline: Intelligence officials brief Congress on Nvidia scandal
stories.summary: After Trump said Jensen Huang was not a security threat, intelligence agencies told congressional aides there was no evidence the woman at the center of the scandal took direction from Chinese intelligence.
stories.why: It bears on questions about Trump's role in Huang's reinstatement.

stories.headline: Three-hour flight delays on tarmacs hit highest level in 15 years
stories.summary: Long tarmac delays have risen to levels not seen in more than 15 years under Trump, with no enforcement in sight.

stories.headline: U.S. probes Iranian ties to up to 50 hacked ships
stories.summary: The U.S. government is investigating possible Iranian links to as many as 50 hacked commercial vessels, officials told NPR, in what may be the latest Iranian cyberattack on critical infrastructure during the war with the U.S.
stories.why: Signals cyber threats to global shipping and infrastructure.

stories.headline: China investigates Shanghai party chief Chen Jining
stories.summary: Xinhua announced an investigation of Politburo member Chen Jining, once seen as a contender for higher office. He is the fourth Politburo member investigated since 2025.
stories.why: Shows how far Xi's purges now reach into the top leadership.

stories.headline: Solomon Islands signs security treaty with Australia, ending China pact
stories.summary: The Solomon Islands ended its 2022 security agreement with China in favor of a treaty with Australia. The new accord precludes foreign military bases.
stories.why: A shift in Pacific influence away from Beijing.

stories.headline: Leaked figures show Russia has lost almost 500,000 people in Ukraine war
stories.summary: Russia's own leaked data indicate nearly 500,000 deaths tied to the full-scale invasion, which has changed mortality patterns in Russia.
stories.why: Shows the scale of the war's human cost.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO after Trump pushes for reinstatement
stories.summary: Nvidia's board had said Huang would not return, but Trump pushed for it, effectively overriding the board, governance experts say. Huang apologized to employees and said he is in therapy.
stories.why: A president's intervention in a major company's leadership is unusual.

stories.headline: Microsoft declares 'Code Red' after major Outlook outage
stories.summary: A nearly 24-hour Exchange Online and Outlook outage took down email for millions of customers. A bug on networking gateway servers since July triggered it.
stories.why: Shows how fragile widely used cloud services can be.

stories.headline: Half of NASA's aging Mars fleet knocked offline
stories.summary: Perseverance is having trouble transmitting to Earth, while Odyssey is rapidly burning through its dwindling fuel supply.

stories.headline: China launches Shenzhou-24 with Pakistan's first astronaut
stories.summary: China sent three astronauts to its Tiangong station, including Pakistan's Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, the first foreigner on a Chinese crewed mission.

stories.headline: Doctors struggle as parents refuse newborn vitamin K shots
stories.summary: Doctors say disinformation is driving refusals of routine vitamin K shots, which help prevent a rare but devastating bleeding disorder in newborns.
stories.why: Shows a preventable health risk to infants.

stories.headline: Mortality gap between Black and white Americans is shrinking
stories.summary: A new report shows significant progress on racial health disparities, though many persist.

stories.headline: Trump's rescue of Nvidia's Huang brings political risks
stories.summary: The president's intercession to reinstate Huang has linked their fates. Nvidia's board is also facing criticism over its handling of the crisis.
stories.why: Ties a major tech firm's fortunes to the White House.

stories.headline: California homeowners say wildfire-proofing barely cuts insurance bills
stories.summary: Some homeowners have spent thousands making homes safer from wildfires, yet their insurance bills have barely dropped.
stories.why: Affects insurance costs in fire-prone areas.

stories.headline: Detroit Lions owner Martha Firestone Ford dies at 101
stories.summary: Ford took over the team after her husband's 2014 death and was one of a handful of female NFL owners.

stories.headline: Steelers bench Aaron Rodgers, start Mason Rudolph against Broncos
stories.summary: Pittsburgh benched Rodgers after offensive struggles led to consecutive losses following a 6-2 start.

stories.headline: NFL Thanksgiving slate: Eagles visit Cowboys in middle game
stories.summary: The Eagles visit the Cowboys in the middle game of the NFL's Thanksgiving tripleheader.

stories.headline: CFP committee rewards Tennessee, drops Indiana in rankings
stories.summary: The latest playoff rankings gave Tennessee more credit, while Indiana fell after weeks of close calls.

stories.headline: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade marks 100th year with 100 inflatables
stories.summary: New York's parade celebrates its 100th procession with 100 inflatables, including new characters.

stories.headline: Nollywood actor Pete Edochie dies at 79
stories.summary: The veteran Nigerian actor rose to prominence in 1987 in a TV adaptation of Chinua Achebe's novel Things Fall Apart.

stories.headline: New London Museum opens Saturday at Smithfield Market
stories.summary: The museum's new site opens following a £437m restoration project.

today.summary: Clear today, with a high of 58° and a low of 36°. No rain expected.
